description: Kete additions to the orchestrations-v1 plan-file vectors (proposed to kete-code-platform docs/contracts/test-vectors/orchestrations-v1/plan-files.json; until it carries them, kete-code's Go and TypeScript readers check these): a nesting cap of 8 levels (deeper is not_json; a Kete addition the platform's reader doesn't have yet), minus zero, a lone surrogate in a member name, and duplicates spelled with \u escapes. Same shape as plan-files.json `files`.
